about: The round point shovel as the skeleton holds it, first and third person (Earthwork A2, docs/worldgen/earthwork_a2.md 6). Points, bounds: item block units of the shovel mesh as client/ShovelItemRenderer draws it (meshes/round_point_shovel.aflmesh.json + (0.5, -0.23132, 0.5); y up the handle, the blade at the bottom, its load face to +z; tools/build-round-point-shovel-v1.mjs prints them). Scale 1: 1.48 m over all to the top of its D grip (2026-10-22), as the real shovel. Held two-handed as a shovel is dug with: the left hand at grip_end (the middle of the D grip's crossbar, 2026-10-22), the right at grip, down the handle; grip_low is the right hand's place for a heavy lift, blade the middle of the blade (it goes into the ground), tip its point.
